answer: A bond is refunded only after 14 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The glacier counter is kept in kernel and signal exposes each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 14 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The attacker spends 298 dollars and 1 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
